CONFIDENTIAL
April 3, 1941 MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY 756
Assassination of a male Formosan in French Concession / H

At 4.30 p.m., April 1, 1941, a male person was shot from behind and seriously wounded outside house 193 Rue Wagner by a lone desperado who made good his escape. The wounded man was immediately conveyed to the St. Marie's Hospital by French Police but, owing to the serious nature of his wounds, he succumbed at 10.30 p.m. even date.

Subsequent enquiries ascertained that the deceased was one named TSEU HOONG NYIEH (周鴻業), Formosan, age 42 years, residing at House 5, Lane 68, Rue Lemaire. He was well educated and had worked for many years in educational and newspaper circles in Canton which accounted for his being able to speak the Canton dialect.

The victim came to Shanghai before the 1937 Sino-Japanese hostilities and took up the post of editor of the "Canton Daily News" on North Szechuen Road. Following the outbreak of the hostilities he became employed with the Japanese Military Authorities as a member of an intelligence section and was promoted to the post of officer in charge of the intelligence section in French Concession last summer. He therefore removed to the present address.

Tseu Hoong Nyieh was heavily addicted to the use of heroin and consumed $30 worth heroin per day in consequence of which he was well acquainted with Korean drug dealers. There is, however, no truth in the statement that he was connected with any heroin organizations.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

1941年4月3日 市警察局档案室 756号
法租界一名台湾男子被刺杀案 / H

1941年4月1日下午4时30分，一名男子在瓦格纳路（Rue Wagner）193号门外被一名独自作案的亡命之徒从背后枪击，身受重伤，凶手随即逃脱。伤者虽由法国巡捕立即送往圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital），但因伤势过重，于当日晚10时30分不治身亡。

经后续调查查明，死者名为周鴻業（TSEU HOONG NYIEH），台湾人，现年42岁，居住在勒梅尔路（Rue Lemaire）68弄5号。他受过良好教育，曾在广州的教育界和报界工作多年，因此能说粤语方言。

受害者在中日敌对行动（1937年）爆发前来到上海，担任北四川路《广东日报》的编辑。战事爆发后，他受雇于日本军方当局，任职于情报部门，并于去年夏天晋升为法租界情报部门负责人。因此，他搬至现址居住。

周鴻業有严重的海洛因毒瘾，每日吸食价值30美元的海洛因，因此与韩国毒品贩子熟识。然而，所谓他与任何海洛因组织有关联的说法并不属实。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别科）
卷宗

April 2, 1941. Afternoon Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News, Cheng Yien Pao and Sin Wan Pao

MURDER OF EMPLOYEE OF KOREAN MORPHINE DEN ON RUE WAGNER

Chow Hung-yeh (周鴻業), age 36, native of Canton,
an employee of a Korean morphine den, resides at No. 5,
Lane No. 68, Rue Lemaire. At 4.30 p.m. yesterday, as Chow
was walking in front of No. 193 Rue Wagner, he was shot at
from behind and was wounded in the backbone. The gunman made
good his escape. The wounded man was removed to the St.
Marie Hospital by ambulance but he succumbed to his wounds
at 10.30 p.m.
It is learned that prior to the Sino-Japanese
hostilities, Chow Hung-yeh was in the employ of the "Kwangtung
Daily News" (廣東日報) on North Ssechuen Road.

D.I. Pan

《中美日报》、《诚言报》及《新晚报》

瓦格纳路韩国吗啡馆雇员被杀案

周鸿业（Chow Hung-yeh，即周鴻業），36岁，广东籍，
系瓦格纳路一家韩国吗啡馆的雇员，居住在勒梅尔路
（Rue Lemaire）68弄5号。昨日下午4时30分，周氏
在瓦格纳路193号门前行走时，遭人从背后开枪射击，
击中脊柱。枪手成功逃脱。伤者由救护车送往圣玛丽
医院（St. Marie Hospital），但于当晚10时30分因伤
重不治。
据悉，在中日敌对行动爆发前，周鸿业曾受雇于
北四川路的《广东日报》（Kwangtung Daily News）。
